question: Does a representation preserving domain-specific temporal pre-intervention learning dynamics predict the sign of fixed-budget counterfactual marginal value on held-out and genuinely disjoint manifests better than the existing six-feature aggregate representation?
hypothesis: A deterministic six-dimensional latent encoding of the frozen 72-dimensional domain-by-time learning-state trajectory will improve sign/balanced-accuracy prediction of intervention value relative to the byte-identical R27/R30 six-feature control, including on one prospectively admitted disjoint sixth manifest, without additional intervention budget, capacity, model calls, held-out outcomes, or post-result tuning.
competing_explanations: representation bottleneck: useful causal-value information exists in the pre-intervention trajectory but aggregation discards it
cross-manifest invariance/evidence bottleneck: richer state predicts known regimes but does not transfer
observability bottleneck: current pre-intervention state does not contain sufficient variables to predict intervention value

inputs.name: transfer
inputs.source: sealed R27/R30 manifest; constituent prefixes independently hash-verified in workflow

inputs.name: third
inputs.source: sealed R27/R30 manifest; constituent prefixes independently hash-verified in workflow

inputs.name: fourth
inputs.source: sealed R27/R30 manifest; constituent prefixes independently hash-verified in workflow

inputs.name: fifth
inputs.source: sealed R27/R30 manifest; constituent prefixes independently hash-verified in workflow

frozen_design.split: Stage 1: four outer leave-one-manifest-out folds over transfer/third/fourth/fifth. Stage 2: fit only on all four existing manifests, then evaluate once on sixth; sixth outcomes unavailable to fitting/selection.
frozen_design.ordering: manifest order transfer,third,fourth,fifth,sixth; candidate allocations in the byte-identical R27 lexical list; domain order code,structured,technical_prose; temporal transitions low-to-high budget.
frozen_design.data_budget: 1744 adaptation bytes per candidate allocation; source prefixes exactly R27/R30 sizes
frozen_design.compute_budget: one deterministic primary run plus one byte-identical replay; PCA power iteration max 256 iterations/component; no hyperparameter search
frozen_design.capacity: R27 motif capacity 256; raw trajectory 72 dims; latent dimension exactly 6; ridge lambda exactly 1; no external model calls
frozen_design.evaluator: positive marginal value iff actual advantage > 0; balanced accuracy and sign accuracy from frozen predictions; false-positive rate over actual non-positive candidates

representations.A_control: byte-identical R27 marginal six-feature ridge model, lambda=1, policy value obtained by summing marginal predictions versus equal allocation
representations.B_raw: 72-D signed domain x temporal-step x six-feature policy trajectory; ridge regression lambda=1 on policy actual advantage
representations.C_latent: deterministic unsupervised PCA learned from training-manifest 72-D trajectories only, exactly 6 components, then ridge regression lambda=1 on policy actual advantage

falsification_controls: held-out temporal reversal applied after training

classification_rules.supported: valid AND Stage1 latent macro balanced_accuracy >=0.65 AND latent-control >=+0.10 AND positive latent delta on >=3/4 heldouts AND latent macro false-positive rate <= control; AND Stage2 latent sign_accuracy >=0.80 AND latent-control sign_accuracy >=+0.20 AND latent false-positive count <= control.
classification_rules.mixed: valid AND not supported AND (Stage1 supported OR raw-control macro balanced_accuracy >=+0.05 OR latent-control macro balanced_accuracy >=+0.05 OR latent improves Stage1 but prospective Stage2 fails).
classification_rules.negative: valid AND neither supported nor mixed; specifically no >=+0.05 raw or latent macro balanced-accuracy improvement sufficient to establish additional usable state information.
classification_rules.invalid: any parent/input/code identity mismatch, missing positive/non-positive class in a required fold, held-out leakage, post-freeze tuning, budget/capacity/model-call drift, replay mismatch, provenance/accounting failure.

expected_information_gain.supported: observable pre-intervention dynamics contain transferable intervention-value information lost by aggregate representation; next test is frozen latent-state bounded intervention selection.
expected_information_gain.raw_positive_latent_negative: information exists but the frozen 6-D encoder is inadequate; improve representation architecture, not allocator rules.
expected_information_gain.negative: weaken current-observable-state sufficiency; escalate to causal observability/hidden-state instrumentation rather than more calibration gates.

rsi_relevance: precursor only; even supported is not autonomous or recursive improvement
preregistration_note: This preregistration and executable code must be committed together before the primary workflow run. Contributor evidence is adoption-candidate-only until independently reproduced and officially qualified.
